analysis.title: Standard Nuclear Inc. (STDN): First Take: Solid 3Q26 results as backlog improves
key_insights: STDN 3Q26 revenue of $6.0mn beat GSe of $5.7mn and FactSet consensus of $5.5mn.
3Q26 reported EBITDA of ($14.8mn) was below GS's ($3.2mn) estimate. Adjusted EBITDA excluding share-based compensation was ($4.5mn).
3Q26 net income of ($13.1mn) was ahead of GSe of ($19.6mn), helped by interest income of $2.0mn versus GSe of $1.7mn.
Total Contract Backlog more than doubled to $577.2mn at end of 3Q26 from $241.5mn at end of 2Q26. Funded Backlog nearly doubled to $119.6mn from $61.9mn.
Qualified Pipeline fell to $844.7mn from $986.3mn in 2Q26, but recovered from about $696mn in late August as new opportunities replaced those converted into executed contracts.
GS keeps a Buy and a 12-month price target of $18 (44.2% upside from $12.48). The target weights DCF (~$19/sh) and EV/EBITDA ($18/sh) 50/50.
Key risks: dependence on early-stage customers, uncertain timing of regulatory licensing approvals, competition and feedstock availability.

market_movers.rationale: Revenue beat and backlog more than doubled to $577.2mn in 3Q26. Upside of 44.2% to the $18 target from $12.48.

earnings_insights: STDN 3Q26 (reported 11/12/2026) revenue $6.0mn actual vs GSe $5.7mn and FactSet consensus $5.5mn.
3Q26 EBITDA ($14.8mn) reported vs GSe ($3.2mn). Adjusted EBITDA ($4.5mn) excluding share-based compensation.
3Q26 net income ($13.1mn) reported vs GSe ($19.6mn). Interest income $2.0mn vs GSe $1.7mn.

GS estimates: FY12/26E revenue $17.1mn, EBITDA ($15.7mn), EPS ($0.56). FY12/27E revenue $62.1mn, EBITDA $6.8mn, EPS ($0.37). FY12/28E revenue $368.9mn, EBITDA $243.8mn, EPS $1.24. These are GS forecasts, not reported figures.
GS quarterly EPS estimates: 9/26E ($0.13), 12/26E ($0.12), 3/27E ($0.09). 6/26 EPS shown as ($0.12).
risk_factors: Dependence on the success of early-stage customers.
Timing of regulatory licensing approvals remains uncertain.
